# Environment model

The included table reconstructs the 1976 U.S. Standard Atmosphere below 84.852 km geopotential altitude. It supplies temperature, pressure, density, speed of sound, and Sutherland dynamic viscosity.

It is a climatological standard atmosphere, not a measured atmosphere for a California-to-Hawaii date. Winds are explicitly zero. For a trajectory study, replace the wind columns with date/latitude/longitude/altitude data from a validated model or observation source and preserve the frame transformation into Earth-fixed and inertial coordinates.
